title: Matroska / WebM (EBML) signature
summary: Matroska (MKV) and WebM files begin with the EBML (Extensible Binary Meta Language) header: 0x1A 0x45 0xDF 0xA3 followed by the EBML version and DocType ('matroska' or 'webm').
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: EBML is a binary XML-like format: elements have an ID (variable-length), size (variable-length), and data.
WebM is a subset of Matroska using VP8/VP9/AV1 video and Vorbis/Opus audio.
Matroska supports multiple tracks, chapters, attachments, and tags.
